name: IBM Quantum Learning
notes: Primary authoritative source for foundational quantum concepts. IBM Quantum Learning course material is peer-reviewed by IBM Research staff.

name: Qiskit Textbook (learn.qiskit.org)
notes: Official Qiskit textbook with circuit examples and Qiskit code. Trust level 1 — maintained by IBM Quantum team.

name: NIST Quantum Information Glossary
notes: US federal standards body. Highest authoritative weight for definitions. Suitable for short_definition and mathematical_explanation fields.

name: Quantum Computing Stack Exchange
notes: Community-verified Q&A. Trust level 2 — all records from this source require human review regardless of quality score.

name: arXiv Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
notes: Preprint server. Use only for algorithm-level content (e.g., Shor's, Grover's). Requires expert human review before publishing.

name: Manual Admin Curation
notes: Hand-authored candidate records by project admins. Source ID used when a JSON candidate file was written manually, not fetched from the web.
